Budget watchdog warns the cost of Ottawa’s borrowing goes beyond the deficit, Canada's National Observer reports.

The most popular vehicle border crossing between Michigan and Ontario last month was the Gordie Howe International Bridge, according to the Bridge and Tunnel Operators Association, The Canadian Press reports.
The saga surrounding former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has riveted Silicon Valley like few other stories, from reports of extramarital affairs to his resignation last, The Canadian Press reports.

Iran says the US military carried out several attacks on Qeshm Island in southern Iran, while at least five ships were set on fire by mines in the Strait of Hormuz earlier in the day, Euronews reports.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s party has repeatedly claimed the vote was ‘stolen’ by Arab-led parties, possibly with foreign assistance, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
